verdict.rationale: Slack is a genuine two-way integration: incidents can be created, acknowledged and resolved from Slack, and alert messages carry acknowledge actions. Teams appears only as an alert channel and a place to call the AI SRE, and GitHub only receives AI-suggested fix pull requests, with no state syncing back. Ticketing is shown for Linear rather than Jira. Missing for 10: any Jira integration, any Zoom integration, evidence of bidirectional state sync with Teams and GitHub, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
